title: Real harness logos in the usage pills
text: The status bar shows how much of each AI coding tool's plan limits is used. Each pill now begins with that tool's own logo (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) instead of a hand-drawn stand-in and small meter, followed by each limit and its percentage. The percentage turns orange or red as a limit runs low, and a click still lists every limit with when it resets.
